purpose: Component-library visual direction exploration; not implementation or acceptance.

variants.title: A · 墨白精密
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE beautifully crafted high-fidelity desktop B2B component-library style exploration image for Mono Design, with sharp legible Chinese UI text and detailed realistic UI components. This is a flat front-facing design specimen, no laptop/device frame, no perspective, no photographic objects. Landscape image approximately 1600x1100 logical composition, high resolution. A slim top specimen banner labels the variant; the rest is a real usable resource-management app above a compact component-state specimen strip. No charts, revenue metrics, promotional hero, marketing CTA, gradients, glassmorphism or illustrations.

SAME CONTENT for all variants: app logo text "Mono"; slim left navigation with "概览", active "资源管理", "组件规范", "设置". Main header title "资源管理", subtitle "管理团队资源与访问状态", primary action "新增资源". Search/filter toolbar includes search placeholder "搜索资源", status select "全部状态", date-range field "2026/10/01 — 2026/10/31". Main content comprises an organization tree with title "团队", "产品组", "设计组", "工程组", a central 4-row selectable resource data table, and a right-side form specimen titled "新建资源". Table columns: "资源名称", "负责人", "状态", "更新时间"; rows use "设计规范 v1", "组件清单", "交付检查", "测试数据", short Chinese names and dates; statuses include text and subtle color: "已启用", "草稿", "已停用". One table row is selected and checkboxes visible; sensible column spacing and row separators; pagination text "共 4 条" with page 1 selected. Right form shows labeled fields "资源名称", "负责人", "资源分类"; empty name field with error "请填写资源名称", owner select, a compact upload area with "上传附件" and file row "design-spec.pdf"; footer actions "取消", "保存". Keep realistic tool-scale controls, not giant buttons.

Bottom specimen strip presents the system: primary/secondary/disabled buttons labeled "主要操作", "次要操作", "不可用"; a visibly focused input, checkbox/radio/switch, small readable calendar specimen with header "2026年10月", and tiny semantic status labels for success, warning and error. These are component examples in a specimen region, not floating unrelated overlays. Use modern system-like Chinese sans-serif fonts (PingFang SC/Noto Sans CJK feel), structured typography with meaningful weight hierarchy, crisp outline icons, readable 14px-equivalent body text, no illegible microtext. Keep the same overall task and content hierarchy across options; stylistic differences must arise from surface organization, control shape, typography weights, row density and boundary treatment, beyond just changing accent colors. Everything fits with generous outer safety margins and no clipping.

Variant A: monochrome Swiss precision, functional and quietly assertive. Banner exact text "A  墨白精密" and small subtitle "MONO DESIGN / PRECISION". White #FFFFFF main surfaces, subtle cool off-white #F7F7F8 outer ground, near-black #18181B ink and filled primary buttons, #E4E4E7 hairline separators. Dense but readable 40px-equivalent table rows, 32px control heights, almost-square 4px corners, no resting card shadows, rigid aligned grid, selected row pale neutral gray. Very light nav, active item black ink on gray. Boundary hierarchy is primarily typography and fine rules, with a flat continuous table canvas; heavier section headings and understated auxiliary text. Small semantic green/amber/red status text and accessible focus indication are permitted. No gold accent, no decorative warm tint. Heroic precision of an excellent enterprise data tool.
